reviews.title: Note the 1.35 Volts
reviews.comment: I bought this memory since it was the cheapest I could get quickly, not noticing that it wants 1.35 volts.  I happened to also be using motherboards that don't recognize the need automatically, and had loads of issues with no POST or snow on the screen.  I put it into my personal rig with a higher end board and everything was great with burn testing.  So, make sure you pair it with the right board.
reviews.author: Random1
